items.title: Accenture (ACN) Agrees To $25 Million DOJ Discrimination Settlement
items.summary: Accenture (NYSE: ACN) has agreed to pay US$25 million to settle U.S. Department of Justice discrimination claims tied to federal contracts. The settlement resolves allegations that Accenture violated federal contract requirements related to employment practices for government work. Accenture reached the agreement with the DOJ without a court judgment, addressing claims focused on compliance with U.S. contractor rules.
